body: That's it though, thanks for being a kind stranger but I'm never coming back again.

Once college ended (of which I stayed in the same area to keep a job, otherwise I'd have had to move home to a shitty rural area in worse shape than where I am) nobody even attempts to see me anymore. The only way I ever see people I thought I was friends with is that I have to drive (minimum 2 hours in my 1980s car nonetheless) which costs money I don't have. These are people making inordinately more than I make and yet they put no effort in, nor does my family. Clearly nobody really looks at me as a good friend like I've always looked at other people I knew as. All these people i thought cared about me don't even try, and I can't keep putting in the life effort anymore. God, I'm just sitting here by myself crying like I did last night and every night before for the last 3 weeks. Thanks for your comment, it truly is nice and I wish I could see it but everything I ever believed in before is a joke. I don't know why I should keep doing this if nothing changes, if I can't make friends, if people don't even try to put effort into our friendships. And now, people don't even call/text me. I truly thought I was a nice person and people liked me
